evidence: Traupman 135: cover up (against the cold), operīre

phrases.latin: Sed prius tē bene operī; māne frīgus est.
phrases.english: But wrap up warm first; it’s cold in the morning.
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 63, 116.
